subject: Balaji Haasan, public recorded method only
scope: Public rashi forecasts and named political-chart comparisons; not a private-consultation reconstruction or predictive-accuracy score
source_quality: Tamil automatic captions contain transcription errors. Claims below are limited to clear repeated terms/context; audio/visual verification is needed for formal equivalence claims. Q&A part 1 and part 8 were checked but captions were not usable for detailed rule extraction. A later transcript fetch returned HTTP 429, so no further YouTube requests were made.

method.operation: Open with sign and qualifying birth-star divisions, then separate star segments
method.engine: Moon sign is computed or supplied; natal star index exists, but exact pada and sign-wide star branching are pending
method.book_alignment: Phaladeepika XIX.2-3 (PDF 229) uses the birth star for a period calculation, but it does not authenticate these forecast branches

method.operation: Broad slow-planet year themes followed by Sun/Mars/Mercury/Venus month branches and ingress boundaries
method.engine: Transit sample at UTC midnight exists; exact ingress/window/retrograde interval engine pending
method.book_alignment: Enabled Phaladeepika XXVI rules only cover four specific planet-house combinations, not general month synthesis

method.input: Planet's house relative to sign or natal ascendant, sign lordship and aspect
method.operation: Associate a planet's house, lordship and aspects with multiple topic houses
method.engine: Moon/ascendant whole-sign houses and narrow transit rules exist; lordship, aspects and topic synthesis pending
method.book_alignment: Phaladeepika XXVI.22 (PDF 332) covers eighth-from-Moon Saturn adversity, not the precise 3rd/7th/10th aspect claims. XV.20-21 (PDF 197) permits derived references, not an outcome by itself

method.input: Candidates' charts where available, or DOB-only affidavits
method.operation: Compare natal strength, transit favorability, yogas/exchanges and present periods; acknowledge missing chart/time
method.engine: Full-time/location natal ascendant exists; no reproducible strength/yoga/exchange evaluator; date-only must not synthesize lagna
method.book_alignment: XV.25 (PDF 198) requires three strengths for a favorable house judgment; this rule is explicitly disabled, not a surrogate for Balaji's undisclosed strength scoring

method.input: An original chart, time-dependent natal data
method.operation: References active major/sub/sub-sub periods in candidate analysis without deriving system in video
method.engine: Phaladeepika XIX.2-4-derived Moon-star major period offsets and Self-Instructor proportional subperiod arithmetic exist; third-level and exact calendar dates not present
method.book_alignment: A 120-year star-based system is book-verified, but it is not proven to be Balaji's specific period system

method.input: Role or life-stage qualifier, year/month/star subgroup
method.operation: Address employed/business/married/separated/parent/student audience with topical branches and remedies
method.engine: No automatic subgroup synthesis; requires eligibility guard and source for each emitted claim
method.book_alignment: XXVI.19 (PDF 330) supports only a traditional generic children-related reading for Jupiter fifth; cannot infer a child's marriage or fertility probability

method.input: Original horoscope vs affidavit birth date vs missing time
method.operation: Say when lagna and dasha cannot be computed from available data
method.engine: Time and location explicitly required for lagna; birth time required for Moon sign/period; no guessed defaults
method.book_alignment: Calculation boundary, not a predictive verse

not_established: Ayanamsha or node convention Balaji uses
Named exact period system or calendar-year conversion
Use of divisional charts, Shadbala, Ashtakavarga, KP or Nadi
Reliability on individual clients or real-world outcomes
output_pattern: Sign and nakshatra audience, slow-planet yearly overview, planetary house/lord/aspect explanations, monthly timing and life-role branches, favorable/adverse sections, practical or ritual remedies. This is a descriptive pattern, not a verbatim voice clone or license to make unsupported life predictions.
safety: No medical diagnosis, fertility probability, lifespan assertion, financial guarantee or real person's outcome based on these examples. Election accuracy is separate and not established.
falsifiability: A future individual-reading comparison must freeze chart inputs, exact predicted event/window, consented outcomes and misses before calculating agreement.
